title: Mailbox native-route miss names its cause and keeps a bounded diagnostic (first step for the transient mailbox 404)
outcome: When a mailbox read or ACK falls through from the exact native lookup to the domain or central route and then 404s, the error is typed (native_mailbox_route_miss) and names the native lookup's outcome, the caller and mailbox key, the coordination store and the server instance. A bounded in-memory record of recent fall-throughs is readable through the existing diagnostics route. Routing semantics are unchanged.
acceptance: A read or ACK whose native lookup misses and whose fallback then 404s returns the typed native_mailbox_route_miss error naming the observed lookup outcome, caller and mailbox key, coordination store and server instance, with no message bodies, receipts or secrets. Shown by a behavioural test that also shows a clean listed read and an ACK with the original receipt still work.
GET /api/diagnostics/mailbox-relay-wakes returns nativeRouteMisses with at most 64 recent read and ACK fall-throughs, held in memory, without bodies or receipts. Shown by a behavioural test.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
